audit.why: Melee duelist who spikes hard on items. Adaptive Defenses (P) shields against your damage type on every auto, so short trades pay her, not you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) is 140/115/90 and anchors you in an arena; she is untargetable on the dash. World Ender is 120/100/80 and out-lasts a single Ultimatum if you spend it after she lands.
audit.corrected: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) locks you in an arena on 140s and she is untargetable on the dash — don't spend your combo into it. Ult after she lands and out-drain the duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: She goes untargetable through the R dash — waiting it out beats dumping your combo into it. Hookshot (E, 16/15/14/13/12) needs a wall; Tactical Sweep (W, 15/14/13/12/11) heals her off the outer half, so Grievous Wounds matters.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto her. Infernal Chains (W) drags her back to the centre if she doesn't leave the zone — hold it for Hookshot (E, 16s at rank 1), which needs a wall, so fight in open lane. Adaptive Defenses (P) shields against your damage type each auto, so short trades pay her. Tactical Sweep (W) heals off the outer half: buy Grievous Wounds before the extended fight.

edits.before: Ultimate interaction changes all-ins. At level 6, reassess the matchup. Aatrox gains his ultimate, but Camille's ultimate or scaling pattern may change whether you can commit.

edits.before: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Camille. W (Infernal Chains) roots him if he doesn't leave the zone: use it to lock him for Q2/Q3 or to cut off his escape. He's mobile, so hold W until after he commits his dash, then chain him so he can't reset or kite your Q. Pop R (World Ender) for the heal, AD and move speed when you fully commit or to survive The Hextech Ultimatum — never burn it for a single Q.
